Hello, Bunny! Shall we have a picnic?
Yes! Let us have a picnic.
Great! I brought our basket.
Can I join you?
Of course! There is room for you.
Where shall we sit?
Let us sit here.
Here is a lovely spot for our picnic.
Next to you, please.
Come and sit beside me.
What would you like from our basket?
An apple, please.
Here is your apple.
A banana, please.
Here is your banana.
No food yet, thank you.
That is okay. We can enjoy the sunshine.
Shall we share some bread, too?
Yes! Let us share.
Here is some bread for each of us.
No, thank you.
That is okay. I will keep it here.
We have milk. Would you like a drink?
Some milk, please.
Here is your milk. Take a little sip.
Not now, thank you.
All right. You can have a drink later.
What shall we do after our picnic?
Let us play together.
Good idea! We can play after tidying up.
Let us tell a story.
Lovely! I have a story to share.
Before we play, shall we tidy our picnic?
I can carry the basket.
Thank you! I will put our food away.
Let us do it together.
Together we can make this spot clean.
Thank you for our picnic. Did you enjoy it?
Yes! Let us picnic again.
I would love that. See you next time!
Thank you for sharing with me.
You are welcome. It is lovely sharing with you.
An apple rolls out of the picnic basket.
Oh! Our apple!
I can catch it. Here you are.
Thank you, Lulu. Good catch!
Lulu takes out a banana.
Would you like this banana?
Yes, please. You can have the apple.
Thank you. I like apples.
And I like bananas!
There is one big piece of bread.
How can we both have some?
We can share it. Half for each of us.
Good idea. One half for you.
And one half for you. Thank you!
Lulu offers Momo some milk.
Some milk?
Not now, thank you. Maybe later.
Okay. I will keep it for you.
Lulu has been helping with the basket.
Your apple is waiting. Sit beside me.
Thank you! Now we can eat together.
This is a happy picnic.
The picnic is over.
I will pack the bread away.
I will carry the basket. See you, picnic spot!
Is there anything left on the grass?
No. It is all clean.

story.title: 1. 苹果滚走了
story.translation: 刚铺好野餐垫，一只苹果滚出篮子。Lulu 帮 Momo 接住它。

segments.text: An apple rolls out of the picnic basket.
segments.cn: 一个苹果从野餐篮里滚了出来。
segments.speaker: narrator

segments.text: Oh! Our apple!
segments.speaker: momo

segments.text: I can catch it. Here you are.
segments.speaker: bunny

segments.text: Thank you, Lulu. Good catch!
segments.speaker: momo

story.title: 2. 谁想吃香蕉
story.translation: Lulu 拿出香蕉，两人商量各自想吃的水果。

segments.text: Lulu takes out a banana.
segments.speaker: narrator

segments.text: Would you like this banana?
segments.speaker: bunny

segments.text: Yes, please. You can have the apple.
segments.speaker: momo

segments.text: Thank you. I like apples.
segments.speaker: bunny

segments.text: And I like bananas!
segments.speaker: momo

story.title: 3. 面包只有一大块
story.translation: 篮子里只有一大块面包。Lulu 提议分成两份，两人都有得吃。

segments.text: There is one big piece of bread.
segments.speaker: narrator

segments.text: How can we both have some?
segments.cn: 怎样我们俩都能吃到呢？
segments.speaker: momo

segments.text: We can share it. Half for each of us.
segments.speaker: bunny

segments.text: Good idea. One half for you.
segments.speaker: momo

segments.text: And one half for you. Thank you!
segments.speaker: bunny

story.title: 4. 现在不想喝
story.translation: Lulu 邀请 Momo 喝牛奶。Momo 现在不想喝，礼貌拒绝，朋友也不催促。

segments.text: Lulu offers Momo some milk.
segments.cn: Lulu 请 Momo 喝点牛奶。
segments.speaker: narrator

segments.text: Some milk?
segments.speaker: bunny

segments.text: Not now, thank you. Maybe later.
segments.cn: 现在不喝，谢谢。也许等一会儿。
segments.speaker: momo

segments.text: Okay. I will keep it for you.
segments.speaker: bunny

story.title: 5. 朋友还没吃到呢
story.translation: Lulu 一直忙着帮忙。Momo 注意到她还没吃，邀请朋友坐下一起享用。

segments.text: Lulu has been helping with the basket.
segments.cn: Lulu 一直在帮忙弄篮子。
segments.speaker: narrator

segments.text: Your apple is waiting. Sit beside me.
segments.cn: 你的苹果在等你呢。坐到我旁边来。
segments.speaker: momo

segments.text: Thank you! Now we can eat together.
segments.cn: 谢谢你！现在我们可以一起吃了。
segments.speaker: bunny

segments.text: This is a happy picnic.
segments.speaker: momo

story.title: 6. 把草地留干净
story.translation: 野餐结束，Momo 收好面包，Lulu 拎起篮子，两人把草地留得干干净净。

segments.text: The picnic is over.
segments.speaker: narrator

segments.text: I will pack the bread away.
segments.speaker: momo

segments.text: I will carry the basket. See you, picnic spot!
segments.cn: 我来拎篮子。再见啦，野餐的地方！
segments.speaker: bunny

segments.text: Is there anything left on the grass?
segments.cn: 草地上还有落下的东西吗？
segments.speaker: momo

segments.text: No. It is all clean.
segments.speaker: bunny
